cohort: 210 pregnant women admitted for delivery at 3 tertiary referral hospitals in Dhaka, Bangladesh, from March to August 2020
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 were more likely to give birth to a preterm baby and undergo a cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 were more likely to undergo a cesarean section.
birth_weight: Measured, but no significant difference found between women with and without COVID-19
